Location: Remote - Preference for Texas or surrounding states

ICF is growing in the south-central United States, and we need more leaders to share in this growth!

ICF’s Texas-based environmental team is seeking a motivated and growth-focused Senior
Environmental Project Manager
to lead sales and delivery of environmental services in Texas and surrounding states. Experience in high-growth sectors including utilities, transmission, and water is a plus, but not required.

typical range 10–20%

win work, lead projects, provide expertise, mentor staff

Mentor, train, and guide junior and mid-level staff
Think strategically to solve client challenges, act with humility to facilitate continual learning and growth
Apply your ingenuity and curiosity to tackle today’s challenges while positioning for tomorrow’s opportunities

Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Policy and Planning, Environmental Sciences, Biology/Ecology/Marine Sciences, or related fields
12+ years of experience in environmental consulting or applicable fields (industry, government, academia)
Demonstrated success developing, winning, and managing environmental planning/permitting projects in the states described above
Excellent oral and written communication skills, including technical writing skills and ability to QA/QC deliverables and provide feedback to staff
Ability to travel to clients or projects in the region described above in reasonable time and cost

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s degree in applicable fields (noted above)
Experience and relationships with transmission, utility, or water-sector clients is a plus
Business mindset with an eye toward client engagement and financial growth
Desire to lead, mentor, and train technical specialists
Ability to develop and present clear solutions to complex problems to clients and regulators

Why you will love working here

Our Team Values Scientific Rigor, Respectful Collaboration, Intellectual Curiosity, And Productive Creativity. We Also Work To Support Our Team Members’ Professional Growth. To This End, We Will

Welcome you warmly to our team and value your knowledge and expertise as an environmental professional
Seek to provide you with diverse experiences including new project types, peers, clients, and geographies
Offer flexible work arrangements and support work-life balance to the maximum extent possible within the constraints of the role
Connect you with leaders and technical experts across ICF to share innovative ideas, provide expert solutions, and to help you learn and grow
Support career development to sharpen your business and project management skills, hone your expertise, and accelerate your growth
Invest in you with generous programs, such as health coverage, tuition reimbursement, access to professional development resources, 401k matching, Employee Stock Purchase Plan, and charitable donation matching
Strong opportunities for growth into local business leadership with demonstrated capabilities and success
Offer an exciting opportunity to be part of something important, working with integrity on projects that matter, and making a difference in the communities in which we live

DEEPAK BUILDERS & ENGINEERS INDIA LIMITED is an established construction and engineering company operating in India, with a focus on delivering high-quality infrastructure and building projects. jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

AS A SENIOR TECHNICAL PROGRAM MANAGER — ML/AI, YOU WILL:

Own and drive complex, cross-team ML/AI programs end-to-end — from scoping and planning through execution and launch — across model infrastructure, inference pipelines, AI functions, Cortex AI services, and AI-powered application features
Partner with ML Engineers, Research Scientists, Product Managers, and Engineering Leaders to define program roadmaps, surface dependencies, and build execution plans that account for the unique uncertainty and iteration cycles inherent to ML/AI development
Coordinate cross-org launches for AI features that span ML infrastructure, application surfaces (Streamlit, Notebooks, Cortex Code), and core platform — ensuring all teams ship cohesively and on time
Navigate the ambiguity of AI development — adapt program structures to handle model experimentation cycles, evaluation gates, accuracy/latency tradeoffs, and the non-linear nature of ML research-to-production timelines
Establish program governance and reporting cadences — track milestones, risks, decisions, and engineering health with clarity and rigor, and proactively escalate to leadership when programs need intervention
Drive cross-functional alignment between ML/AI engineering, product, design, infrastructure, security, and legal/compliance teams on AI feature launches, model deployment, and responsible AI practices
Identify and resolve systemic execution bottlenecks — design lightweight processes and tooling-backed workflows that improve engineering velocity without adding overhead
Own AI launch readiness — coordinate model evaluation sign-off, performance benchmarking, safety review, and documentation across engineering, product, and trust/safety teams
Represent ML/AI programs to senior leadership with crisp, data-backed status updates and strategic recommendations that connect program execution to business outcomes

OUR IDEAL SENIOR TPM — ML/AI WILL HAVE:

Required:

5+ years of technical program management experience at a cloud or AI-native technology company, with a track record of owning cross-team programs end-to-end
Demonstrated experience with ML/AI programs — you understand the ML development lifecycle (training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring) and can manage programs around its unique iteration patterns and uncertainty
Strong technical depth — ability to engage meaningfully with ML engineers and research scientists on model architecture, inference infrastructure, evaluation metrics, and deployment tradeoffs
Proven ability to operate in ambiguity — ML/AI programs don't follow predictable timelines; you know how to structure execution around experimentation cycles and adapt plans as signals emerge
Experience managing programs spanning 4+ engineering teams with competing roadmaps and shared dependencies
Excellent communication skills — you synthesize complex technical and research concepts into clear, actionable narratives for leadership, product, and cross-functional audiences
Strong program management fundamentals: dependency management, risk frameworks, milestone governance, stakeholder alignment, and escalation discipline

Preferred:

Experience with LLM inference, fine-tuning, RAG architectures, or AI function platforms at production scale
Background in model serving infrastructure, GPU/accelerator resource management, or ML platform engineering
Familiarity with responsible AI practices — model evaluation, bias detection, safety review, and compliance workflows
Experience with Snowflake's architecture or data cloud ecosystem
Working knowledge of ML observability — monitoring model performance, drift detection, and production quality metrics
Background in launching customer-facing AI features where accuracy, latency, and cost are critical tradeoffs

SNOWFLAKE VALUES WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

Get It Done — You turn the inherent ambiguity of ML/AI into executable plans and deliver outcomes. You don't wait for perfect clarity — you create it.
Own It — You treat your programs as your own end-to-end. You anticipate risks before they surface and drive resolution without being asked.
Make Each Other the Best — You build bridges across ML research, engineering, and product. You create shared context and alignment that makes the whole organization move faster.
Think Big — You see beyond the current sprint. You think about what it takes for Snowflake's AI capabilities to operate at 10x scale and help build the frameworks to get there.

About Us

Hoare Lea is a human-centric and planet-conscious engineering consultancy. We offer intelligent and sustainable solutions to complex design challenges for the built environment throughout the UK and further afield.

So, in joining Hoare Lea, you will experience a business that enriches your knowledge, supports your wellbeing, and welcomes your individuality. You’ll have the opportunity to participate in our 9-day fortnight scheme, thriving community groups, varied social and networking events, and extensive professional and technical development schemes. We also offer an extensive benefits package, including private medical cover, an electric vehicle salary sacrifice scheme, stock options, and 25 days of annual leave (increasing with service), alongside flexible and hybrid working.

Whatever your ambitions or circumstances, our aim is to enable everyone to develop their knowledge, give their best, and enjoy what they do.

About The Role

Our multi-disciplinary software, product, and data team serves as a central hub of digital expertise and innovation, supporting projects across the company. We work collaboratively with engineers, consultants and other specialists to use data and technology to solve real-world problems and improve the services we provide to our clients.

We have an opportunity for a Data Analyst/Scientist or Senior Data Analyst/Scientist to play a key role in using data, analytics, statistical methods and data science to generate insight, support decision-making and improve our engineering services.

This is a broad analytical role. You will work across the full lifecycle of a problem: understanding stakeholder needs, exploring and assessing data, identifying appropriate analytical approaches, communicating findings and, where appropriate, developing statistical or machine-learning models or client-ready insights/tools. This is a role for someone who enjoys variety and has a critical eye for finding the right solution for the problem. Sometimes this may be exploratory analysis, a dashboard or a set of clearly defined metrics; in other cases, it may involve forecasting, statistical modelling, machine learning or building/working with AI.

It's an exciting time to join our Digital team. Working alongside a range of specialist engineers and consultants, you will be joining a collaborative, knowledgeable, highly engaged team, and offer a supportive, flexible, and high-performing work culture. Our team has recently worked on creating data science-led for managing estates in hospitals, building energy forecasting models, and harnessing data on building performance to create better designed buildings of the future.

Work with engineers, consultants, product teams and other stakeholders to understand their needs and translate sometimes ambiguous questions into well-defined analytical problems.
Develop and implement data-driven solutions to solve real-world business problems across the company.
Use SQL, Python and other analytical tools to investigate datasets, identify trends and relationships, test hypotheses and generate actionable insights.
Apply appropriate statistical techniques, forecasting methods, ML and AI approaches where they add value to the problem being solved.
Collaborate with the product and software engineering teams to turn analytical work into reusable tools, workflows and data-driven products where appropriate.
Develop reproducible and maintainable analytical code, following best practices, including version control, testing, and peer reviews.
Contribute to the development of analytical and data science capability across the business by sharing approaches, reusable methods and good practice

Essential Skills

Experience applying data and analysis to real-world business, engineering or operational problems.
Strong analytical problem-solving skills, with the ability to take an initially ambiguous question and determine an appropriate analytical approach.
Ability to work on projects independently and own deliverables.
Strong proficiency in Python for data manipulation, analysis, visualisation and data science (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn).
Proficiency in data querying languages (e.g., SQL). Solid understanding of software engineering best practices (version control, unit testing, code review, etc.).
Strong experience with data visualisation frameworks (e.g., PowerBI, Streamlit).
Experience applying machine learning and AI, including generative AI, to real-world problems where it provides clear benefit.
Familiarity with statistical concepts and their application in data analysis.
Solid communication skills, capable of effectively engaging with and presenting findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Understanding of data governance, privacy, responsible AI and other relevant standards.

Desirable Skills

Knowledge of the engineering industry and its challenges.
Experience with one of the major machine learning frameworks (TensorFlow or PyTorch).
Knowledge of mathematical optimisation methods, such as linear, integer or constraint optimisation, and associated tools (e.g. OR-Tools).
Experience with MS Fabric or equivalent data warehousing solution.
Experience working in a cloud computing environment.
Familiarity with containerisation and deployment technologies (e.g., Docker, CI/CD pipelines).

At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

AS A SENIOR TECHNICAL PROGRAM MANAGER — ML/AI, YOU WILL:

Own and drive complex, cross-team ML/AI programs end-to-end — from scoping and planning through execution and launch — across model infrastructure, inference pipelines, AI functions, Cortex AI services, and AI-powered application features
Partner with ML Engineers, Research Scientists, Product Managers, and Engineering Leaders to define program roadmaps, surface dependencies, and build execution plans that account for the unique uncertainty and iteration cycles inherent to ML/AI development
Coordinate cross-org launches for AI features that span ML infrastructure, application surfaces (Streamlit, Notebooks, Cortex Code), and core platform — ensuring all teams ship cohesively and on time
Navigate the ambiguity of AI development — adapt program structures to handle model experimentation cycles, evaluation gates, accuracy/latency tradeoffs, and the non-linear nature of ML research-to-production timelines
Establish program governance and reporting cadences — track milestones, risks, decisions, and engineering health with clarity and rigor, and proactively escalate to leadership when programs need intervention
Drive cross-functional alignment between ML/AI engineering, product, design, infrastructure, security, and legal/compliance teams on AI feature launches, model deployment, and responsible AI practices
Identify and resolve systemic execution bottlenecks — design lightweight processes and tooling-backed workflows that improve engineering velocity without adding overhead
Own AI launch readiness — coordinate model evaluation sign-off, performance benchmarking, safety review, and documentation across engineering, product, and trust/safety teams
Represent ML/AI programs to senior leadership with crisp, data-backed status updates and strategic recommendations that connect program execution to business outcomes

OUR IDEAL SENIOR TPM — ML/AI WILL HAVE:

Required:

5+ years of technical program management experience at a cloud or AI-native technology company, with a track record of owning cross-team programs end-to-end
Demonstrated experience with ML/AI programs — you understand the ML development lifecycle (training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring) and can manage programs around its unique iteration patterns and uncertainty
Strong technical depth — ability to engage meaningfully with ML engineers and research scientists on model architecture, inference infrastructure, evaluation metrics, and deployment tradeoffs
Proven ability to operate in ambiguity — ML/AI programs don't follow predictable timelines; you know how to structure execution around experimentation cycles and adapt plans as signals emerge
Experience managing programs spanning 4+ engineering teams with competing roadmaps and shared dependencies
Excellent communication skills — you synthesize complex technical and research concepts into clear, actionable narratives for leadership, product, and cross-functional audiences
Strong program management fundamentals: dependency management, risk frameworks, milestone governance, stakeholder alignment, and escalation discipline

Preferred:

Experience with LLM inference, fine-tuning, RAG architectures, or AI function platforms at production scale
Background in model serving infrastructure, GPU/accelerator resource management, or ML platform engineering
Familiarity with responsible AI practices — model evaluation, bias detection, safety review, and compliance workflows
Experience with Snowflake's architecture or data cloud ecosystem
Working knowledge of ML observability — monitoring model performance, drift detection, and production quality metrics
Background in launching customer-facing AI features where accuracy, latency, and cost are critical tradeoffs

SNOWFLAKE VALUES WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

Get It Done — You turn the inherent ambiguity of ML/AI into executable plans and deliver outcomes. You don't wait for perfect clarity — you create it.
Own It — You treat your programs as your own end-to-end. You anticipate risks before they surface and drive resolution without being asked.
Make Each Other the Best — You build bridges across ML research, engineering, and product. You create shared context and alignment that makes the whole organization move faster.
Think Big — You see beyond the current sprint. You think about what it takes for Snowflake's AI capabilities to operate at 10x scale and help build the frameworks to get there.

About Us

Hoare Lea is a human-centric and planet-conscious engineering consultancy. We offer intelligent and sustainable solutions to complex design challenges for the built environment throughout the UK and further afield.

We provide a wide range of engineering and consultancy services, including acoustics, air quality, building services (MEP), fire, lighting, security and sustainability to name but a few. Together, our highly skilled teams use technical expertise and problem-solving skills to bring buildings to life. We ensure that whatever the building, its design is outstanding, and its operations meet the needs of the communities it serves.

We are as committed to providing an environment where everyone can realise their unique potential. So, in joining Hoare Lea, you will experience a business that enriches your knowledge, supports your wellbeing, and welcomes your individuality. You’ll have the opportunity to participate in our 9-day fortnight scheme, thriving community groups, varied social and networking events, and extensive professional and technical development schemes. We also offer an extensive benefits package, including private medical cover, an electric vehicle salary sacrifice scheme, stock options, and 25 days of annual leave (increasing with service), alongside flexible and hybrid working.

Whatever your ambitions or circumstances, our aim is to enable everyone to develop their knowledge, give their best, and enjoy what they do.

About The Role

Our multi-disciplinary software, product, and data team serves as a central hub of digital expertise and innovation, supporting projects across the company. We work collaboratively with engineers, consultants and other specialists to use data and technology to solve real-world problems and improve the services we provide to our clients.

We have an opportunity for a Data Analyst/Scientist or Senior Data Analyst/Scientist to play a key role in using data, analytics, statistical methods and data science to generate insight, support decision-making and improve our engineering services.

This is a broad analytical role. You will work across the full lifecycle of a problem: understanding stakeholder needs, exploring and assessing data, identifying appropriate analytical approaches, communicating findings and, where appropriate, developing statistical or machine-learning models or client-ready insights/tools. This is a role for someone who enjoys variety and has a critical eye for finding the right solution for the problem. Sometimes this may be exploratory analysis, a dashboard or a set of clearly defined metrics; in other cases, it may involve forecasting, statistical modelling, machine learning or building/working with AI.

It's an exciting time to join our Digital team. Working alongside a range of specialist engineers and consultants, you will be joining a collaborative, knowledgeable, highly engaged team, and offer a supportive, flexible, and high-performing work culture. In a time where building and energy resilience is ever more important, we are driving forward innovation to make an impact with data and technology.

You will have the opportunity to engage in a variety of high-impact projects, working on challenging problems for some of the UK’s most notable organisations, including the NHS and Oxford University. Our team has recently worked on creating data science-led for managing estates in hospitals, building energy forecasting models, and harnessing data on building performance to create better designed buildings of the future.

In this key and varied role, you can expect to:

Work with engineers, consultants, product teams and other stakeholders to understand their needs and translate sometimes ambiguous questions into well-defined analytical problems.
Develop and implement data-driven solutions to solve real-world business problems across the company.
Use SQL, Python and other analytical tools to investigate datasets, identify trends and relationships, test hypotheses and generate actionable insights.
Apply appropriate statistical techniques, forecasting methods, ML and AI approaches where they add value to the problem being solved.
Collaborate with the product and software engineering teams to turn analytical work into reusable tools, workflows and data-driven products where appropriate.
Develop reproducible and maintainable analytical code, following best practices, including version control, testing, and peer reviews.
Contribute to the development of analytical and data science capability across the business by sharing approaches, reusable methods and good practice

About You

To be successful in this role you’ll need:

Essential Skills

Experience applying data and analysis to real-world business, engineering or operational problems.
Strong analytical problem-solving skills, with the ability to take an initially ambiguous question and determine an appropriate analytical approach.
Ability to work on projects independently and own deliverables.
Strong proficiency in Python for data manipulation, analysis, visualisation and data science (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn).
Proficiency in data querying languages (e.g., SQL). Solid understanding of software engineering best practices (version control, unit testing, code review, etc.).
Strong experience with data visualisation frameworks (e.g., PowerBI, Streamlit).
Experience applying machine learning and AI, including generative AI, to real-world problems where it provides clear benefit.
Familiarity with statistical concepts and their application in data analysis.
Solid communication skills, capable of effectively engaging with and presenting findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Understanding of data governance, privacy, responsible AI and other relevant standards.

Desirable Skills

Knowledge of the engineering industry and its challenges.
Experience with one of the major machine learning frameworks (TensorFlow or PyTorch).
Knowledge of mathematical optimisation methods, such as linear, integer or constraint optimisation, and associated tools (e.g. OR-Tools).
Experience with MS Fabric or equivalent data warehousing solution.
Experience working in a cloud computing environment.
Familiarity with containerisation and deployment technologies (e.g., Docker, CI/CD pipelines).

For candidates joining at Senior
level, we would additionally expect you to lead more complex or ambiguous analytical projects, shape analytical approaches and overarching priorities, work independently with senior stakeholders, review and support the work of others, and help raise analytical standards across the team.
